fixes: Medications accordion fix not delivered to index.html (deployment error). v9.10.88 added the Medications Settings accordion to the versioned HTML file but the fix was never copied into index.html — the file GitHub Pages actually serves. The service worker cached the broken index.html under clinbridge-v9.10.88, so replacing index.html on GitHub had no effect. Fix: index.html rebuilt from corrected source. Version bump forces service worker to delete stale cache and re-fetch clean.
